Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
Article 54 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 sets several dates of application. From which date does Article 6(7) (conditions for including a category in Annex I, Part A or Part B) apply?

response.text: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 has several dates of application laid down in its Article 54. As of which date does Article 6(7), covering the conditions for placing a category in Annex I, Part A or Part B, apply?
